proposals.before: In the twelfth year he retired and was granted Grand Master of the Gold Seal and Purple Ribbon with recording duties, retaining his attendant status.
proposals.after: In the twelfth year he retired and was granted Grand Master of the Gold Seal and Purple Ribbon, retaining his attendant status.
proposals.reason: Standard title is 金紫光祿大夫; source 光錄 is likely a 祿/錄 corruption, and recording duties invents a sense from the wrong character.

proposals.before: In the twelfth year he retired from office and was granted Grand Master of the Gold Seal and Purple Ribbon with recording duties, retaining his attendant status.
proposals.after: In the twelfth year he retired from office and was granted Grand Master of the Gold Seal and Purple Ribbon, retaining his attendant status.
proposals.reason: Literal English inherits the false recording-duties reading of 錄 in 光錄 for standard 光祿.

proposals.after: (Son Lingfu)

proposals.reason: 驾部郎 is Gentleman of the Coach Bureau; Master of Coaches misrenders the office.

proposals.before: Jimu was favored by the Minister of the Masters of Writing, the Prince of Pingping, Hong, and repeatedly slandered Yu to Hong.
proposals.after: Jimu was favored by the Minister of the Masters of Writing, the Prince of Jianping, Hong, and repeatedly slandered Yu to Hong.

proposals.before: He again requested to be Administrator of Dongguan.
proposals.after: He again requested that Huihui be made Administrator of Dongguan.
proposals.reason: Silent subject continues the prior request for the son-in-law 惠徽, not an office for Xi himself.

proposals.before: He entered mourning for his mother; his grief and ruin won praise, and the magistrate of his home county, Zhuge Chanzhi, reported it upward in a public memorial of release.
proposals.after: He entered mourning for his mother; his grief and ruin won praise, and the magistrate of his home county, Zhuge Chanzhi, reported it upward in a public memorial.
proposals.reason: 公解言上 means submitting an official public report upward; 'of release' invents a sense of 解 absent from this administrative context.

proposals.before: He headed the chief rectifier of his home district, Director of the Palace Parks, Senior Clerk attached to the chief administrator of Yangzhou, and chief administrator on the Guard Army staff of the Prince of Shixing, Jun.
proposals.after: He held the posts of chief rectifier of his home district, Director of the Palace Parks, Senior Clerk attached to the chief administrator of Yangzhou, and chief administrator on the Guard Army staff of the Prince of Shixing, Jun.
proposals.reason: 領 marks concurrent tenure of the listed offices; 'headed the chief rectifier' wrongly treats 中正 as supervised rather than held.

proposals.before: He headed the chief rectifier of his home district, Director of the Palace Parks, Senior Clerk attached to the chief administrator of Yangzhou, and chief administrator on the Guard Army staff of the Prince of Shixing, Jun.
proposals.after: He held the posts of chief rectifier of his home district, Director of the Palace Parks, Senior Clerk attached to the chief administrator of Yangzhou, and chief administrator on the Guard Army staff of the Prince of Shixing, Jun.
proposals.reason: Same error as idiomatic: 領本邑中正 means he held the chief-rectifier post, not that he headed that office as a superior.

proposals.before: Once the Yang region was divided and analyzed, the border reached the utmost southland. Measured against Han domains, only Danyang and Kuaiji remained.
proposals.after: Once the Yang region was partitioned, the border reached the utmost southland. Measured against Han domains, only Danyang and Kuaiji remained.
proposals.reason: 分析 here means administrative partition/division of Yang Circuit, not intellectual analysis; 'analyzed' invents a sense absent from the Chinese.

proposals.before: Once the Yang region was divided and analyzed, the border reached the utmost southland; measured against Han domains, only Danyang and Kuaiji remained.
proposals.after: Once the Yang region was partitioned, the border reached the utmost southland; measured against Han domains, only Danyang and Kuaiji remained.
proposals.reason: Same 分析 mistranslation as in the idiomatic field: partition of territory, not analysis.

proposals.before: From the Jin relocation of the court until the Taixuan era, for some hundred years there was no alarm of war. Within the region, all was tranquil.
proposals.after: From the Jin relocation of the court until the Taiyuan era, for some hundred years there was no alarm of war. Within the region, all was tranquil.
proposals.reason: 太元 is the Eastern Jin Taiyuan reign; Taixuan would be 太玄 and is a clear reign-name error.

proposals.before: From the Jin relocation of the court until the Taixuan era, for some hundred years there was no alarm of war; within the region, all was tranquil.
proposals.after: From the Jin relocation of the court until the Taiyuan era, for some hundred years there was no alarm of war; within the region, all was tranquil.
proposals.reason: 太元 must be rendered Taiyuan, not Taixuan.

decisions.reason: Focus unit 遷尚書右僕射 names the Right Vice Director; English Left reverses 右 and is unsupported.
Same Left/Right error in the literal field: 右僕射 is Right, not Left.
十年…復為尚書右僕射 again has Right; idiomatic Left repeats the same side error.
Literal likewise misrenders 右僕射 as Left; the proposed Right matches the Chinese.
Local 金紫光錄大夫 is the standard office 金紫光祿大夫; CText transmits 光祿, and 'with recording duties' invents a separate sense from 錄 that the title does not carry.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 十二年，致仕，拜金紫光祿大夫，常侍如故。

decisions.reason: Literal 'recording duties' depends on the same false reading of 錄 in the title; removing it restores the ordinary Grand Master title (光祿).

decisions.reason: Header 子 靈符 marks Son Lingfu; 弟 in the following narrative is Lingfu as younger brother of Shanshi, not a correction of this header.
Literal Younger brother contradicts 子; Son: Lingfu parallels 子 山士.
駕部郎 is the Coach Bureau gentleman (郎), not a 'Master of Coaches'; the proposed office title matches the Chinese.
諡曰定子 is the full posthumous name Dingzi; omitting 子 as mere Ding drops part of the title.
Same omission in the literal field: 定子 must be rendered Dingzi in full.
賞位二階 rewards two grades/steps of rank (階), not noble ranks; 'ranks of nobility' invents a sense absent from 階.
Literal repeats the nobility misreading of 賞位二階; two grades of rank is accurate.
魏犨 is Wei Chou (犨, chōu); Chu is a wrong reading of the personal name in the allusion.
Literal likewise needs Chou for 犨; Chu misreads the character.
建平王宏 is the Prince of Jianping; Pingping drops 建 and invents a nonexistent fief name.
Same Jianping correction required in the literal field for 建平王.
又請為東莞太守 continues Xi's prior request for son-in-law 惠徽 (s0176), not a self-appointment; the silent beneficiary is Huihui.
公解言上 is an official public report upward; 'of release' invents a sense of 解 not present in this administrative phrase.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 本縣令諸葛闡之公解言上

decisions.reason: 領本邑中正 means he held/concurrently held the home-district rectifier post; 'headed the chief rectifier' wrongly makes 中正 a subordinate office.
Literal has the same 領…中正 misreading; he held the listed posts, including chief rectifier.
揚部分析 is administrative partition of the Yang region; 'analyzed' invents an intellectual sense absent from the Chinese.
Literal likewise needs partitioned for 分析, not 'divided and analyzed'.
太元 is the Eastern Jin Taiyuan era; Taixuan would require 太玄 and is a reign-name error.
Literal must likewise render 太元 as Taiyuan, not Taixuan.

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0014 restores the English personal name to Wei Chou so it matches 魏犨 / Chou rather than the mistranslation Chu.
